list: Official 55-trophy list as PlayStation publishes it, counts as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.guide: The platinum is the reward for everything else: it unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, with no task of its own. Work the roadmap stages in order so the counted grinds land last and the platinum arrives as the final checkmark.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum unlocks with the last one.
Work the roadmap stages in order so no grind is left for the end.
Finish the story first — its trophies are the foundation of the 54.
Clear the contact and stranger strands in stage 3 before the grinds.
Work the counted grinds in stage 4 so the counters climb together.
Finish the activities in stage 5 and the combat in stage 6.
Close the economy in stage 7: launder, spend, buy garages, register vehicles.
Watch the tracker's progress bar — 54 of 54 is the trigger.
The platinum pops with the last trophy earned; there is nothing else to do.

trophies.guide: The opening mission, Gone Fishing. Start a new game and play it from the first scene to the mission-complete screen — the trophy pops with the mission and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Start a new game and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
Follow the mission objectives from the first scene onward.
There is no alternate route — the mission plays straight through.
Finish the mission to its mission-complete screen.
The trophy unlocks at the mission-complete screen.
It cannot be missed: the trophy is the mission's completion reward.
If the attempt fails, replay Gone Fishing from the mission menu.
Check the story menu — Gone Fishing is the first mission listed.
Once it pops, the story moves on to Chapter 1.

trophies.guide: The Chapter 1 finale. Play through the chapter's missions in order; the trophy unlocks when the chapter's last mission ends and Chapter 2 begins.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play every mission of Chapter 1 in story order.
Follow each mission's objectives to its end.
Finish the chapter's closing mission to the end.
The trophy unlocks as Chapter 2 opens.
It is the chapter-complete reward — nothing extra is required.
If a mission fails, replay it from the mission menu.
Check the story menu to see which Chapter 1 missions are done.
The trophy cannot be missed: finishing the chapter is the trigger.
Once it pops, Chapter 2's missions open in order.

If a mission fails, replay it from the mission menu.
Check the story menu to see which Chapter 2 missions are done.
The trophy cannot be missed: finishing the chapter is the trigger.
Once it pops, Chapter 3's missions open in order.

Finish the chapter's closing mission to the end.

It is the chapter-complete reward — nothing extra is required.
If a mission fails, replay it from the mission menu.
Check the story menu to see which Chapter 3 missions are done.
The trophy cannot be missed: finishing the chapter is the trigger.
Once it pops, Chapter 4's missions open in order.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

Follow each mission's objectives to its end.
Finish the chapter's closing mission to the end.
The trophy unlocks as the story's final stretch opens.

steps: Play through to the final mission of the campaign.
Follow the final mission's objectives to the end.
Finish the final mission to its ending.
The gold trophy unlocks at the credits roll.
It is the mission-complete reward for the campaign's last mission.
If the attempt fails, replay the final mission from the mission menu.
Check the story menu — the final mission is the last one listed.
The trophy cannot be missed: finishing the mission is the trigger.
Once it pops, the platinum is one step away — the counted grinds remain.

trophies.guide: The 100% gold. The in-game stats screen tracks completion across story, strangers, collectibles and activities — every category in this guide counts toward it. Finish the last open item and this gold pops with it.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Open the in-game stats screen to see which completion categories are open.
Work the guide's stages in order; every category feeds the 100% count.
Finish the story categories first — chapters and named missions.
Clear the contact and stranger strands in stage 3.
Work the collectibles and counts in stage 4.
Finish the activities in stage 5 and the combat in stage 6.
Close the economy in stage 7: launder, spend, buy garages, register vehicles.
Check the stats screen after each stage to see what is still open.
The gold unlocks when the last category reaches 100%.

trophies.guide: 250 stunts across Leonida. Stunts are the jumps, near-misses and airtime moments the game counts — they accumulate across all play, so drive fast, take ramps and keep moving, and watch the total on the stats screen.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Play normally and attempt stunts: jumps, ramps, near-misses and airtime.
Each stunt adds one to the running total of 250.
Check the running total on the stats screen as you go.
Pass 50, then 100, then 200 — the counter climbs steadily across all play.
Stunts accumulate across all play, so no single session has to carry it.
Drive fast and take ramps whenever you see one — the count rewards aggression.
Near-misses and airtime count too, not just jumps.
It cannot be missed — the counter never resets.
Keep at it until the counter reaches 250 for the silver.

trophies.desc: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Nine activity types across Leonida, one try each. Races, fishing, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting, drone races and the shooting range are among them — sample one of each type and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Open the activities list and note the nine types.
Try one of each type, even briefly.
Each type counts once, on the first try.
Races, fishing, arcade games and bowling are four of the nine types.
Meditation, hunting, drone races and the shooting range are four more.
One more type remains beyond those eight — try it too.
You only need to try each type, not win or finish it.
It cannot be missed — activities stay open after the story.
The trophy pops when the ninth type is tried.

trophies.desc: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge has its own gold time or score — learn the target pattern, then run it clean. The range tracks each challenge separately, so work through them one at a time.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Open the Shooting Range and pick a challenge.
Learn its targets, then run it for the gold medal threshold.
Each challenge has its own gold time or score.
The range tracks each of the 42 challenges separately.
Work through them one at a time; a gold in one does not help the next.
Clear the early challenges first to learn the range's patterns.
Return to the hard ones with the patterns learned.
Check the range screen to see which of the 42 are still open.
Repeat for all 42 challenges; the silver pops with the last gold.

trophies.desc: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: A Top Fun drone race win at each of the 14 locations. Drone races reward tight lines and throttle control — learn each course's turns, then win it once and move to the next location.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race location on the map.
Race the course and win it once.
Each of the 14 locations needs its own win.
Drone races reward tight lines and throttle control — learn each course's turns.
A win at one location does not count for another.
Move to the next location after each win.
It cannot be missed — the race locations stay open.
Check the map to see which of the 14 locations are still unwon.
Repeat at all 14 locations; the trophy pops with the last win.

trophies.guide: Twenty different races won. Any race type counts, but each race only counts once — variety is the requirement, so spread your wins across the map instead of repeating one favourite.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Pick a race you have not won yet.
Win it; each distinct race counts once.
Any race type counts, but repeating one favourite adds nothing.
Spread your wins across the map for variety.
Pass 5, then 10, then 15 — the count climbs one new race at a time.
Check which races you have already won before picking the next.
It cannot be missed — races stay open after the story.
Use different race types to keep finding unwon races.
Win 20 different races in total.

trophies.desc: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: A fishing challenge against Cal. Take the challenge, out-fish him, and the trophy pops at the result screen. Fishing rewards patience — wait for the bite, then reel steadily.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Find Cal and take his fishing challenge.
Out-fish him in the challenge.
Fishing rewards patience — wait for the bite, then reel steadily.
The trophy pops at the challenge result screen.
If you lose, take the challenge again — it can be retried.
It cannot be missed — the challenge stays open.
Reel steadily once the bite comes; rushing loses the fish.
Beat Cal's catch, not just any catch, to win the challenge.
Once the result screen shows your win, the trophy is yours.

trophies.guide: One arcade game completed. Find an arcade cabinet, start any game, and play it to its end — completion, not a high score, is what counts.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Find an arcade cabinet in Leonida.
Start any arcade game and play it through.
Completion, not a high score, is what counts.
The trophy pops when the game ends.
Any cabinet and any game qualifies — pick the shortest one.
It cannot be missed — arcade cabinets stay open.
Play to the game's end, not to a score target.
If the game ends early, start another one.
Once a game completes, the trophy pops.

steps: Play Andy's missions in order as they unlock.
Contact strands unlock as the story advances.
Finish his final mission to the end.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
It is the mission-complete reward, not a hidden objective.
If a mission fails, replay it from the mission menu.
Check back as the story advances if Andy's next mission is not open yet.
The strand cannot be missed — it stays open once unlocked.
Stage 3 — the contacts and strangers.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Watch for stranger markers on the map as you travel.
Meet a stranger and play their strand to its end.
Each completed strand counts once toward the 8.
Some strands only open after story progress, so check back as the story advances.
Strangers appear as question marks on the map.
Pass 2, then 4, then 6 strands — the count climbs one strand at a time.
A strand counts only when its missions are all finished.
It cannot be missed — strangers stay on the map.
Complete 8 strands in total for the silver.

steps: Find a meditation spot and meditate there.
Each spot counts once toward the 18.
Meditation spots are quiet scenic places across Leonida.
Work through them county by county so none is left for the end.
Pass 6, then 12 spots — the count climbs one spot at a time.
Sit and meditate; the spot counts once the meditation completes.

Check the map for areas you have not meditated in yet.
Meditate at all 18 spots.

trophies.desc: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: A unique animal hunted for Bret. Take Bret's hunt, track the animal it names, and take it down cleanly — the trophy pops when the hunt is handed in.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Take Bret's hunting request.
Track the unique animal it names.
Take it down cleanly.
Hand the hunt in to Bret.
The trophy pops when the hunt is handed in.
It cannot be missed — the hunt stays open.
Follow the trail the hunt gives you; the animal is the one it names.
A clean takedown is the point — do not scare it off first.
Once the hand-in completes, the trophy is yours.

trophies.guide: Three complete Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — collect a full set, then two more. Sets are tracked in the collection screen, so check which cards are missing before hunting blind.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Check the collection screen for which cards are missing.
Collect the cards of one set to complete it.
Cards are scattered across Leonida.
Each full set counts once toward the 3.
Complete a second set, then a third.
Check the collection screen between hunts so you never chase a card you own.
It cannot be missed — the cards stay where they are.
Work one set at a time instead of grabbing cards at random.
Complete 3 full sets for the silver.

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK spots are spread across the whole state — use the in-game map markers and work through them region by region; the counter tracks each location once.

steps: Find a WAiNK location and use it.
Each location counts once toward the 100.
The WAiNK spots are spread across the whole state.
Use the in-game map markers and work region by region.
Pass 25, then 50, then 75 — the counter climbs one location at a time.
A location you already used adds nothing the second time.
It cannot be missed — the spots stay open.
Check the map markers to see which regions are still thin.
Reach 100 locations for the silver.

trophies.guide: Fifty challenges completed. Challenges are the game's small open-world tasks — they accumulate across everything you do, so play widely and the counter climbs. The stats screen shows the running total.

steps: Play across activities, driving, combat and exploration.
Challenges are the game's small open-world tasks.
Each completed challenge adds one to the total of 50.
Watch the challenge counter on the stats screen.
Pass 10, then 25, then 40 — the counter climbs as you play widely.
It cannot be missed — the counter never resets.
Vary what you do; one activity alone will not fill the counter fast.
Check the stats screen to see the running total.
Reach 50 completed challenges.

trophies.desc: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Missable in practice: it needs your partner beside you. Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and escape together — the trophy pops when the heat dies with both of you free. Do it during a partner story beat, when your partner is guaranteed to be present.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Be with your partner during a story beat that keeps them beside you.
Raise a 4-star wanted level.
Break line of sight and escape together until the wanted level clears.
The trophy pops when the heat dies with both of you free.
MISSABLE: it needs your partner beside you — do it while a partner story beat guarantees their presence.
Four stars is the requirement — less will not count.
Escape together: the trophy needs both of you free when the heat dies.
Do not lose your partner mid-escape or the attempt fails.
Stage 6 — do the missable flags here, while the moments are live.

trophies.desc: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Missable in practice: three shops in a row, with your partner, without ever losing the wanted level. Plan a route of three close shops, rob them one after another, and keep moving — stopping or losing the heat breaks the chain. Do it while a partner is with you.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Be with your partner and pick three shops close together.
Rob the first, then the second, then the third without stopping.
Keep the wanted level alive through all three robberies.
Stopping or losing the heat breaks the chain.
MISSABLE: it needs your partner beside you — do it while a partner is with you.
Plan the route first — three close shops, in one line.
Keep moving between robberies; standing still wastes the chain.
The trophy pops after the third robbery with the heat still alive.
Stage 6 — do the missable flags here, while the moments are live.

trophies.guide: One hundred vehicles discovered. Every distinct vehicle you drive counts once — variety is the requirement, so drive everything you find instead of sticking to one favourite. The vehicle list tracks what you have discovered.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Drive any vehicle you have not discovered yet.
Each distinct vehicle counts once toward the total.
Variety is the requirement — drive everything you find.
The vehicle list tracks what you have discovered.
Pass 25, then 50, then 75 — the count climbs one new vehicle at a time.
Sticking to one favourite adds nothing after the first drive.
It cannot be missed — vehicles stay available.
Check the vehicle list to see what you have not driven yet.
Discover 100 vehicles.

trophies.desc: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Five enemies down in one Combat Focus. Pick a fight with a group, wait until five are in view, then trigger Combat Focus and drop them all before it ends — grouped enemies in an open area make it far easier.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Find a group of five or more enemies in an open area.
Wait until five are in view at once.
Trigger Combat Focus with all five in view.
Take down five before the focus ends.
Grouped enemies in an open area make it far easier.
It cannot be missed — Combat Focus can be used again.
Do not trigger the focus early, with fewer than five in view.
Drop all five inside the one focus use — a sixth enemy after it ends adds nothing.
Once the fifth falls inside the focus, the trophy pops.

trophies.desc: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Missable: an unscheduled departure from VCIA. Get to VCIA, take a plane, and leave without a flight plan — the trophy is tied to that one departure, so do it the first time you have a plane at the airport.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Get to VCIA with access to a plane.
Take off without a scheduled flight — an unscheduled departure.
The trophy pops as you leave airport airspace.
MISSABLE: the trophy is tied to that one departure — do it the first time you have a plane at the airport.
Do not leave on a scheduled flight first.
VCIA is the airport in the description — the departure must start there.
Take the plane up and out; the trophy is the departure itself.
If you miss the moment, the departure is gone — do it at the first chance.
Stage 6 — do the missable flags here, while the moments are live.

trophies.guide: The Rhino tank. Get into a Rhino and use it — survive the heat it draws and the trophy pops. Tanks draw heavy attention, so pick your moment and keep moving.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Get into a Rhino tank.
Use it in the open and survive the response it draws.
Tanks draw heavy attention, so pick your moment and keep moving.
The trophy pops once the tank run is done.
It cannot be missed — the Rhino can be found again.
Keep moving while the heat is on you; standing still draws fire.
The Rhino is the vehicle the description names — any other tank does not count.
Survive the response the Rhino draws.
Stage 6 — combat and chaos.

trophies.desc: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Flagged missable because the clean run is the point: rob a jewelry store without being detected at all. Go in quiet, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm — one detection and the attempt fails.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Pick a jewelry store and plan a quiet entry.
Avoid cameras and staff sightlines throughout.
Take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm.
One detection and the attempt fails.
MISSABLE: the clean run is the point — go in quiet or the attempt is wasted.
Plan the entry first; rushing in gets you seen.
Leave the same way you came in — quiet and fast.
The trophy pops once you are clear with the goods, undetected.
Stage 6 — do the missable flags here, while the moments are live.

trophies.guide: Five bank vaults robbed, each with an escape. Vaults are the big jobs — plan the entry, crack the vault, then get clear before the response closes in. Each completed vault-and-escape counts once.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Find a bank vault and plan the entry.
Rob the vault, then escape the response.
Each completed vault-and-escape counts once toward the 5.
Vaults are the big jobs — plan the entry, crack the vault, then get clear.
It cannot be missed — vaults stay open.
An escape is part of the count — a robbery without one adds nothing.
Get clear before the response closes in.
Check how many vaults you have completed before the next one.
Repeat for 5 vaults for the silver.

trophies.desc: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: One armored truck robbed, with an escape. Ambush a truck on the road, take its cargo, then break away before the response arrives — speed matters more than firepower here.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Find an armored truck on the road and stop it.
Take its cargo.
Escape the response for the trophy.
Speed matters more than firepower here.
It cannot be missed — trucks keep running the roads.
Break away fast once the cargo is yours.
The escape is part of the trophy — the robbery alone does not count.
Ambush the truck where the road gives you room to run.
Stage 6 — combat and chaos.

trophies.guide: All 52 areas of Leonida explored. The map tracks each area as you enter it — drive the whole state, county by county, until every area is filled in. The map screen shows which areas are still blank.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Drive into each area of Leonida; the map fills in as you go.
Each area counts once toward the 52.
Check the map screen for blank areas.
Drive the whole state, county by county.
Pass 13, then 26, then 39 areas — the map fills one area at a time.
It cannot be missed — the map stays open.
An area counts when you enter it, not when you finish anything in it.
Use the map screen to plan the next blank county.
Explore all 52 areas.
